C1366.title: Horizon Bridge Attack
C1366.summary: On June 24, 2022, the Harmony team announced on Twitter that its Horizon bridge had been exploited, resulting in a loss of approximately $100 million. The incident involved a compromise of the bridge's validation mechanism, leading to the large-scale theft of locked assets.

references.title: Nearly $100 Million Stolen: Analysis of the Horizon Cross-Chain Bridge Attack - Zhihu
